title: ml_plan_status.py reads the frozen WSD-S4 checklist export, not the work store, so ML plan ref_states and UNPLANNED flags are stale
note: Found 2026-11-12 by AM-ML. Symptom on main 2026-11-12 ~09:10Z: the tool showed ML-LIVE-FIRST / ML-TIMEFRAME / ML-UNIVERSE-RULE in_flight and FRONTIER-LEVER-HARNESS-COSTS queued, while the store said queued/queued/queued/done. Lane OPDEC-P7-LEVERS (#25218 body) confirmed the files are the frozen export, not git-sync lag. Fix: read rows via checklist_store (checklist-readers-guard names the sanctioned reader), with a test that a store/file disagreement resolves to the store. Also check for any other ML tool that globs the frozen files. Tier 1.
